data.text: Use Hivemind for repository agent coordination: read the shared plan at session start, claim tasks before implementation, and publish shared contracts, decisions, blockers, and handoffs. Hivemind communication is authorized; code pushes, deployment, spending, and unrelated messages require separate authorization.
